glyph_origin: Originally written as 从. Now phono-semantic compound (形聲): semantic 辵 (“walk”) + phonetic 从 (“follow”).
s_page_origin: Ideogrammic compound (會意) – a person (人) walking with another person in the same direction – to follow. Duplication of 人. See the bottom component of 旅 (< 𣃨).
shuowen: 「賣：出物貨也。從出從買。」 (“賣: To put something out and sell it. Derived from 出 and 買.”)
senses: [cóng] (not used alone) to follow; to come after
[cóng] to comply with; to submit to
[zòng] (obsolete in standard Chinese) alternative form of 縱 (“straight; vertical”)
note: glyph_origin is from the traditional page 從; s_page_origin explains the simplified 从.
